title: Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic Speaking Test 3
description: Haqiqiy IELTS/CEFR Speaking formati: Rasmiy Cambridge IELTS 21 Test 3 bo‘yicha Part 1 (Kirish va kundalik mavzular), Part 2 (Cue Card taqdimot) va Part 3 (Tahliliy munozara).

sections.title: Speaking Assessment (Parts 1-3)
sections.instructions: Ushbu bo‘lim 3 ta qismdan iborat. Har bir qism topshirig‘i bilan tanishib chiqing, tayyor bo‘lgach mikrofon tugmasini bosib ovozingizni yozing va saqlang.

questions.question_text:
Part 1: Introduction & Everyday Topics (Speak for 1-2 minutes)

1. When you go shopping, do you usually pay for things by cash or by card?
2. Are you generally careful about how much money you spend?
3. Have you ever spent money on something you didn't need?
4. How important is it to you to save money for the future?

Part 2: Individual Long Turn / Cue Card (1 minute preparation, 2 minutes speaking)

Describe an interesting garden or park you have seen.
You should say:
• Where this garden or park is
• How big it is
• What you saw in this garden/park
And explain why you think this garden/park is interesting.

Part 3: Two-way Discussion (Speak for 2-3 minutes)

1. What are the advantages of having a home with a garden?
2. How could people living in apartment blocks grow plants and vegetables?
3. How interested are people in your country in TV shows and magazines about gardens?
4. Do you think that gardening is a hobby mainly for older people?
5. What are the benefits for people of gardening as a hobby?
6. Will gardening be a more popular hobby in the future?
